description.en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account.

description.zh:
多云的code。取值：
- qcloud：腾讯云。
- aliyun：阿里云。
- hcloud：华为云。
description.en:
The code for the multicloud environment. Valid values:

- qcloud: Tencent Cloud.

- aliyun: Alibaba Cloud.

- hcloud: Huawei Cloud.

description.zh: 数据源ID，由威胁分析根据具体参数计算md5生成。可调用[ListDataSourceLogs](https://api.aliyun-inc.com/#/publishment/document/cloud-siem/863fdf54478f4cc5877e27c2a5fe9e44?tenantUuid=f382fccd88b94c5c8c864def6815b854&activeTabKey=api|ListDataSourceLogs)获取数据源ID。
description.en: The ID of the data source. Threat Analysis calculates this ID as an MD5 hash value based on specific parameters. To obtain the data source ID, call the [ListDataSourceLogs](https://api.aliyun-inc.com/#/publishment/document/cloud-siem/863fdf54478f4cc5877e27c2a5fe9e44?tenantUuid=f382fccd88b94c5c8c864def6815b854\&activeTabKey=api%7CListDataSourceLogs) operation.

description.zh: 数据源参数详情，json数组格式。
description.en: The details of the data source parameters. The value must be a JSON array.

description.zh:
威胁分析的数据管理中心所在地。您需要根据资产所在地域，选择管理中心所在地。取值：
- cn-hangzhou：资产属于中国内地与中国香港
- ap-southeast-1：资产属于海外地域
description.en:
The region where the Data Management Center of Threat Analysis is deployed. Select the region where your assets are located. Valid values:

- cn-hangzhou: Assets are in the Chinese mainland and Hong Kong (China).

- ap-southeast-1: Assets are outside China.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloud-siem add-data-source-log --log-code cloud_siem_waf_xxxxx --data-source-instance-id 220ba97c9d1fdb0b9c7e8c7ca328d7ea --data-source-instance-logs LogCode_:_cloud_siem_qcloud_waf_alert_log_,_LogParas_:_ParaCode_:_api_name_,_ParaValue_:_GetAttackDownloadRecords --account-id 123xxxxxxx --cloud-code hcloud --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2022-06-16 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cloud-siem AddDataSourceLog --region cn-hangzhou --DataSourceInstanceLogs 'LogCode_:_cloud_siem_qcloud_waf_alert_log_,_LogParas_:_ParaCode_:_api_name_,_ParaValue_:_GetAttackDownloadRecords' --CloudCode hcloud --AccountId 123xxxxxxx --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --LogCode cloud_siem_waf_xxxxx --DataSourceInstanceId 220ba97c9d1fdb0b9c7e8c7ca328d7ea
